programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Tha Bing air bhioran 's e dèanamh air an amar-cluiche cuide ri Flop 's Sula ach, 's e briseadh dùil a tha feitheamh air 's gun uisge sam bith san amar! Ge-tà, chan eil fada gus am faic iad gur e cothrom a tha seo geamannan gu tur ùr a chluich! Bing is excited to be going on an outing to the paddling pool with Flop and Sula, but disappointment awaits as they discover that there's no water in the pool! However, they soon realise that this is an opportunity to make up new games!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Às dèidh tubaist bheag, tha am plangaidh aig Bing air a cur san inneal nigheadaireachd 's gun cothrom a tioramachadh mus caidil e. Tha Bing troimhe chèile gun plangaidh ach, tha Hoppity ri làimh son cofhurt a thoirt dha! A little accident at bedtime sees Bing's blankie being sent to the wash, with no way of being dry in time for Bing to get to sleep. Bing is upset but luckily he has Hoppity to offer him some comfort!

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Thig còmhla ri na h-Abadas air turas spòrsail eile agus iad a' sireadh facal ùr: 'sgòth'! Tha na càirdean a' cnuasachadh air an fhacal ùr seo agus tha aon dhiubh a' sealltainn ris na speuran airson faighinn a-mach dè th'ann an sgòth. The friends ponder the word 'cloud' and one of them reaches for the sky to discover exactly what a cloud looks like and what it does.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha Nìp ag adhbharachadh thuiltean air feadh an eilein nuair a tha e a’ tòiseachadh ri cladhach na chadal. Neep causes watery mischief all over the Island when he starts digging in his sleep.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein a’ fiathachadh a charaidean gu àite-obrach athar. Ach chan eil Dadaidh Pheicein a’ leigeil leotha suathadh ann an dad ach an t-ùrlar, is tha sin a’ fàs dòrainneach. Mu dheireadh thall, tha Dadaidh Pheicein a’ sealltainn dhaibh gun urrainn saorsainneachd a bhith air leth spòrsail. Petit invites his friends to his dad's workplace. But his dad won't let them touch anything except the floor and they start to get really bored. Finally, Petit's dad shows them how carpentry can be lots of fun.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Ramsay MacMahon a’ leughadh Seanmhair Eun. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Benji Davies agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Ramsay MacMahon reads Seanmhair Eun, written by Benji Davies and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: The Deep/An Doimhne
programme.desc: Tha Fionn feumach air taic bho na Neachdan. Feumar athair, Tormod Mòr, a stad mus faigh e greim air ulaidh sònraichte. Chan eil Fionn 'son ‘s gum boin athair dhan ulaidh 's gum bi e air a ghortachadh ri linn sin. Saoil ciamar a thèid leotha? Fionn needs help from the Neachdan. His father, Tormod Mòr, must be stopped from getting his hands on a treasure. Fionn doesn’t want his father to touch this treasure and get hurt in the process. How will they get on with this?

programme.title: Na Speuran
programme.desc: Thèid air turas suas dha na speuran cuide ris an Speuradair Zach! Air an turas fànais iongantach seo tha e ag innse dhuinn mu Voyager 1 agus 2 agus mu na chaidh a lorg ann an aon de na miseanan saidheansail a bu shoirbheachail a-riamh. Blast off into space with Astronaut Zach! In this amazing space voyage, he tells us about the discoveries made by Voyager 1 and 2 in one of the most successful scientific missions of all time.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha companaidh lìbhrigidh ùr aig Siùsaidh air a bheil ‘Air a’ Mhionaid’. Tha Pòl airson airgead a dhèanamh airson cuibhlichean ùr a cheannach, mar sin tha e faighinn obair leis a’ chompanaidh aig Siùsaidh. Tha Anna dhen bheachd gun urrainn dhithse na parsailean a thoirt timcheall nas luaithe na Pòl, is chan fhada gus a bheil farpais a’ tòiseachadh eadar an dithis aca. Lil Sue has started a delivery company, Deliver Sue, and in a quest to raise money for a new set of wheels, Dave lands himself a job. Anna thinks she knows how to deliver packages quicker than Dave though, and soon a sibling rivalry unfolds.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha Pòl air a dhòigh nuair a tha e a’ buannachadh inneal-cuideachaidh bhiortail air a bheil Bilidh. A-nis cha bhi a theaghlach às a dhèidh airson gach nì a dhèanamh dhaibh. Ach chan fhada gus a bheil iarrtasan nam Ploc a’ cur Bilidh droil. Dave is thrilled when he wins an electronic home-help device called Barry. Finally, his family can boss something around other than him. It is not long however before Barry is overwhelmed by the Spuds’ demands.

programme.title: Gàrraidhean Mòra
programme.desc: Mairi Rodgers explores Threave Garden near Castle Douglas. Tha Màiri Rodgers a’ gabhail cuairt tro Ghàrradh Threave faisg air Caisteal Dhùghlais.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: The studio guest is Iain MacPherson who hails from Alberta, Canada, and Calum Maclean visits a thriving community project in Glasgow.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Fuine
programme.desc: Cherished trusty recipes and new kitchen creations with Gregor MacLeod and friends. Reasabaidhean gràdhach agus cruthachaidhean ùra bho Ghriogair MacLeòid agus caraidean.

programme.title: Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean/Wild Senses
programme.desc: We explore the surprising ways animals use touch to sense their world, find food and stay out of danger.

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Seata cuirme le Ross Miller Band, clàraichte beò aig Duaisean nan Trads, 2025. A’ gabhail a-steach The Dedication Jigs agus The Drunken Man from Kalabakan. Concert set performed by the Ross Miller Band, originally recorded live at the Trad Awards, 2025. Featured tracks include The Dedication Jigs and The Drunken Man from Kalabakan.

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Tha na seòid a’ cruthachadh reasabaidhean às aonais chruithneachd no bathar-bainne. Wheat and dairy intolerance is widespread, the lads come up with healthy alternatives.

programme.title: Eòrpa
programme.desc: Aithris le Shona NicEanraig bho 2006, a’ rannsachadh mar a tha boireannaich gan cùiltearachd à Moldòbha gu taobh an iar na Roinn Eòrpa – cuid dhiubh a Bhreatainn Shona Henderson’s 2006 report investigating the trafficking of women from Moldova to western Europe, many of whom end up in the United Kingdom. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha Somhairle agus Niamh a’deanamh rud beag ‘pacadh-baidhsagal’, a’ cuir seachad trì laithichean ‘socair sàmhach’ a’ rothaireachd air Slighe Thaobh Spè. Somhairle introduces Niamh to ‘bikepacking’, opting for a ‘relaxed’ three-days cycling the Speyside Way.

programme.title: Brunch le Abigail
programme.desc: Tha an Dutch Baby annasach ach anabarrach blasta. Brunch sònraichte air nach dìochuimhnich thu a’ chiad ghreis. The unusual but extremely delicious Dutch baby is a special brunch that you won't forget in a hurry. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: A’ sireadh Dànachd anns an Roinn Eòrpa, tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ siubhal gu dùthaich nam beann iongantach – Nirribhidh. Còmhla ri a chompanach sreap, Calum Gibb, bidh Coinneach a’ dìreadh ‘Stetind’, stùc le eachdraidh bheairteach a tha air mac-meanmna luchd-sreap a ghlacadh airson còrr is ceud bliadhna. Seeking adventure on a grand scale in Europe, Coinneach Rankin travels to the mountain paradise of Norway. Along with his climbing partner, Calum Gibb, Coinneach makes an ascent of Stetind, a peak with a storied past that has captured the imagination of mountaineers for well over a century. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: From Ice to Fire: The Incredible Science of Temperature
programme.desc: Physicist Dr Helen Czerski explores the narrow band of temperature that has led to life on Earth. She reveals how life began in a dramatic place where hot meets cold, and how every single living creature on Earth depends on temperature for its survival. She uncovers the extraordinary natural engineering that animals have evolved to keep their bodies at the right temperature. And she witnesses the remarkable surgery that's using temperature to push the human body to the very brink of life.

programme.title: The Ruth Ellis Files: A Very British Crime Story
programme.desc: Series re-examining the Ruth Ellis case. Gillian Pachter looks at Ruth's execution and the last-minute attempts to save her life, though Ruth herself was determined to die.

programme.title: Eve and Marilyn
programme.desc: 'She had a total understanding and control of the still camera... she was intelligent enough and sharp enough and beautiful enough to be able to manipulate almost any situation, so it became something which was totally her own...' Eve Arnold, one of the world's leading photo-journalists, remembers photographing Marilyn Monroe over the ten crucial years of Marilyn's stardom and decline. Going back to the original contact sheets and colour material, she tells of their friendship and what it was like as a woman to photograph Marilyn Monroe.

programme.title: Scene by Scene

programme.title: How to Marry a Millionaire

programme.title: Talking Pictures
programme.desc: Sylvia Syms looks at the handsome heroes and gorgeous heroines, pin-ups and bombshells who came to be known as cinema's greatest sex symbols. They were the actors who made audiences' hearts beat fastest - the men and women whom the camera just seemed to love that little bit more than most. The programme hears from the stars themselves talking about what their sex symbol status meant to them, and the good-looking line-up includes Gary Cooper, Jane Russell, Brigitte Bardot, Paul Newman, Robert Redford and Hollywood's ultimate sex symbol, Marilyn Monroe.

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Quiz show presented by Victoria Coren in which knowledge will only take players so far, as patience and lateral thinking are also vital. It is all about making connections between things which may appear, at first glance, not to be connected at all.

programme.title: Eve and Marilyn
programme.desc: 'She had a total understanding and control of the still camera... she was intelligent enough and sharp enough and beautiful enough to be able to manipulate almost any situation, so it became something which was totally her own...' Eve Arnold, one of the world's leading photo-journalists, remembers photographing Marilyn Monroe over the ten crucial years of Marilyn's stardom and decline. Going back to the original contact sheets and colour material, she tells of their friendship and what it was like as a woman to photograph Marilyn Monroe.

programme.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
programme.desc: Classic comedy musical. A transatlantic trip brings romantic problems for showgirls Lorelei and Dorothy, seeking different things from men.

programme.title: Scene by Scene
programme.desc: A rare interview with former Hollywood sex symbol Jane Russell. She talks about her difficult childhood as the eldest and only girl of six siblings, her film career and working with Marilyn Monroe.

programme.title: How to Marry a Millionaire
programme.desc: Three New York models, looking for rich husbands, rent a luxurious apartment together to impress affluent bachelors, but things do not go to plan.

programme.title: Talking Pictures
programme.desc: Sylvia Syms looks at the handsome heroes and gorgeous heroines, pin-ups and bombshells who came to be known as cinema's greatest sex symbols. They were the actors who made audiences' hearts beat fastest - the men and women whom the camera just seemed to love that little bit more than most. The programme hears from the stars themselves talking about what their sex symbol status meant to them, and the good-looking line-up includes Gary Cooper, Jane Russell, Brigitte Bardot, Paul Newman, Robert Redford and Hollywood's ultimate sex symbol, Marilyn Monroe.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Ready to trade town life in the West Midlands for the tranquillity of the North Yorkshire coast, a keen gardener has a £320,000 budget and needs the help of Denise Nurse to move closer to her family and treasured grandson. It’s also an important anniversary for some coastal heroes, as the house hunting coincides with the Royal National Lifeboat Institution’s 200th anniversary. Denise heads to Whitby to join the celebrations.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: The team help the people trying to save Britain’s oldest wooden ship, a football cap brings back treasured memories, and Lucia sees a complicated wooden puzzle at the V&A Museum.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, friends Yafai, Tony, Oliver and Alfie – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Grab a cuppa and watch Roo Irvine present a special show on a subject close to her heart – Asia! programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, friends Yafai, Tony, Oliver and Alfie – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, friends Yafai, Tony, Oliver and Alfie – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies

programme.title: Wild Cameramen at Work
programme.desc: Filming the wildlife in our skies stretches the skills of any wildlife cameraman. Birds move in three dimensions and constantly change direction so keeping them in the frame and in focus is challenging. In the third episode of this illuminating series, Scots-based cameramen John Aitchison and close friend Mark Smith reveal some of the more unlikely corners of the world where they have filmed birdlife, from a rubbish dump in Dehli to a motorway flyover near Birmingham. The results are mesmerising.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Kirsty Wilson and Brian Cuningham show how to help the pollinators in your garden and at Beechgrove as they focus on planting that will attract bees to your plot. Even if you don’t have a garden, Kirsty demonstrates how you can help the local ecosystem by sowing a meadow in a pot. She also discusses the best summer bulbs to plant now for fragrance and colour. Brian is back in the vegetable plot for his summer-long guide to productive gardening for beginners, and there is a demonstration of how to prune spring-flowering shrubs. All that and the week’s handy hints.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie visits Bee Edge Farm near Eyemouth to help open the barn doors and let the cows out for summer. Continuing to mark Landward’s 50th anniversary, Cammy catches up with a farming pioneer who was never one for sitting on the fence, and Rosie is stepping back in time in Aberdeenshire to find out what one old farm building can tell us about our agricultural past. Elsewhere, Leanna is on the trail of a walrus that has been turning up in harbours around Scotland's north coast.

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: PC Cailean McLeod returns to his home island of Lewis to search for a missing 16-year-old who walked out into the snow and has now been missing for 48 hours. In the stunning landscape of Glencoe, police have to deal with traffic chaos while trying to free a motorhome from a roadside ditch. In Shetland, it’s the busiest night of the year as police deal with Viking revellers and a drunk driver.

programme.title: Icons of Football
programme.desc: Davie Cooper holds a unique place in Scottish football folklore. This portrait of the Rangers and Motherwell legend picks apart the many sides to one of the greatest and often misunderstood players of his generation. Bestowed with a talent and a left foot that could have taken him anywhere in his career, Davie refused overtures to leave out of a deep-rooted attachment to his family and his Lanarkshire upbringing. Despite his unrivalled talent, Davie suffered setbacks, but he always rose to the challenge and delivered. With contributions from Graeme Souness, Derek Ferguson, Iain Ferguson, and the unique insights of his brother John.

programme.desc: Steven Thompson presents highlights of Partick Thistle v St Mirren in the first leg of the Premiership play-off final.

programme.title: Confessions of a Teenage Fraudster
programme.desc: At just 18 years of age, Elliot is an international fraudster who is on the run from law enforcement around the globe. He pursues his scams around the world, chasing the dream of a lavish lifestyle. But it is a lonely existence, which leaves him craving connection with family and friends. It also proves to be a perilous one – trips to Dublin, Toronto and elsewhere accrue investigators and police officers, several of whom speak in interviews and archive footage, keen to ensure he serves time for his crimes. With a trail of crime stretching across continents, Elliot becomes more paranoid than ever that capture and a long stint in a foreign jail is just around the corner.

programme.title: Confessions of a Teenage Fraudster
programme.desc: Facing deportation to the UK, it seems inevitable that Elliot will fall into the hands of British cops who have put together an extensive case of his crimes. Once again, though, he has other ideas. After four years of travelling the world spending fraudulently accrued money, he continues to be chased by investigators and cops. In truth, the one thing Elliot desires as much as freedom is a settled life. But even when he thinks he’s found it, with a new home and friends, there is no escape from his trail of lies and deception. Eventually, with his life unravelling, his spending becoming chaotic and a growing resentment for the fraud that has funded his lifestyle, justice catches up with Elliot.

programme.title: Stranger in My Family
programme.desc: Luke discovers 'dad' is not his biological father and that he is mixed race. That triggers a search for a bartender called Carlos, who his mum met on a girls’ holiday in the 90s.

programme.title: Asia
programme.desc: Asia's jungles are exceptionally diverse, but whilst they provide shelter, food and opportunity, they are also full of dangers and hidden threats. In monsoon forests, tigers tenaciously hunt their prey, and prehistoric-looking rhinos play courtship games akin to kiss chase. In tropical rainforests, female orangutans must search far and wide to find their perfect mates. And in the little-known forests of Iraqi Kurdistan, a new Persian leopard population is growing amid minefields.

programme.title: Freddie Flintoff's Field of Dreams
programme.desc: Time is running out for sporting legend Freddie Flintoff to help his unlikely cricket team transform, both on and off the field. With the Indian tour reaching its final few days, attention turns to life back in England, and Freddie has his work cut out dealing with thoughts of back home and future fears. Hoping to end the tour on a high, Freddie and the boys head to one of the oldest cricket clubs in India to take on their toughest opponents yet.

programme.title: The Traitors India
programme.desc: The loss of a key Innocent sends shockwaves through the group, leaving the players overwhelmed. The palace becomes a pressure cooker of mistrust, where every glance and every move is second-guessed. In the mission, the journey comes full circle as players vote for their least trustworthy player in the game. Every decision exposes fractures in their unity, forcing hard conversations and unveiling hidden dynamics. Stakes are higher than ever at the Circle of Shaq. Will the group rally to make the right call, or will doubt and deception lead them astray once again?

programme.title: The Traitors India
programme.desc: Only a handful of players stand at the final juncture of the game. In their last challenge, teamwork is the key. But players must rely on their instincts and use everything they've learned throughout the game to navigate this crucial moment. Each choice brings them closer to uncovering the truth - or falling victim to one last betrayal. As the players gather for the final Circle of Shaq, the pressure builds to an unbearable crescendo. Will the Innocents triumph by exposing the Traitors at last, or will the Traitors outwit them to claim victory? One thing is certain - trust was gained only to be broken!

programme.title: Crazy Rich Asians
programme.desc: New Yorker Rachel Chu accompanies her longtime boyfriend, Nick Young, to his best friend's wedding in Singapore. Excited about visiting Asia for the first time but nervous about meeting Nick's family, Rachel is unprepared to learn that Nick has neglected to mention a few key details about his life. Not only is he the scion of one of the country's wealthiest families, but also one of its most sought-after bachelors. Being on Nick's arm puts a target on Rachel's back, with jealous socialites and, worse, Nick's own disapproving mother taking aim. It soon becomes clear that the only thing crazier than love is family.

programme.title: Panorama
programme.desc: Cute, funny, and sometimes surreal, AI-generated videos are flooding our social media feeds, but behind the dancing dogs and talking fruit lies a far darker world. In this Panorama investigation, reporter Marianna Spring explores how AI slop is shaping what we see, what we believe and who we can trust. From scam adverts and cloned voices to deepfake fraud, political manipulation and racially charged disinformation, the programme reveals how cheap and easily available AI tools are being weaponised. We ask, in the age of artificial intelligence, will seeing ever be believing again?

programme.title: MasterChef
programme.desc: It’s the last round of heats. A new batch of amateur cooks enter the MasterChef kitchen ready to show off their culinary skills, hoping to get through to the next round.

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah travels from California to Japan to experience the latest age-defying techniques and examine the true meaning of life.

programme.title: Do You Know Your Place?
programme.desc: As the week edges towards its conclusion, Vernon Kay brings the quiz to Jedburgh. As ever, Paul Gorton is on tour-guiding duties, delivering fun facts, fibs and distractions along the way. TV icon Anneka Rice, comedian Shane Todd and Radio 1Xtra DJ Remi Burgz all have their sights set on the top of the leaderboard.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: We head to the Kent coast to revisit a renovation that's taken some time to finish. Jacqui checks out a large terrace as well as a tiny flat in a tale of two contrasting projects.

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his Sardinian railway adventure, arriving in Mamoiada to investigate the town’s extraordinary pagan traditions. In a menacing mask, black sheepskin and 30 kg of cowbells, Michael embraces the role of a mamuthone, who wards off evil spirits. Taking a 1950s diesel railcar, Michael journeys across the island to Macomer, where he discovers the railway’s surprising connection to a pioneering Welsh railway engineer. His adventure concludes at Italy’s largest cork factory, where a team of expert sniffers safeguard the integrity of the world’s finest wines.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With the promise of warmer days ahead, Monty makes a start on planting up some of his spectacular summer containers. He’s also got leeks to plant out and shares some advice on how to make your own fertiliser. Frances Tophill heads to Berkshire to learn more about biodynamic gardening and the benefits it can bring. It’s also time for an update from Adam Frost’s new garden, where things are slowly starting to take shape. In Cumbria, a couple of growers share their love of auriculas as they get ready for this year’s RHS Chelsea Flower Show. And as part of Mental Health Awareness Week, a forager explains how her garden helped her to heal after being diagnosed with cancer.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The big political issues of the day.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Rick Edwards presents the quiz with a third dimension. In traditional quiz shows, questions have just right and wrong answers. But here, there is a twist - the Impossible answer. It's not just wrong, it couldn't possibly be right. Each day, 24 regular contestants compete for a possible £10,000 jackpot. Right answers keep them on track for the big money, but if at any stage they give an Impossible answer, that immediately knocks them out and they must try again the next day. Every show climaxes with the £10,000 question as the daily winner faces one last challenge. Three right answers trigger a spectacular cascade of 10,000 pound coins from a giant exclamation mark, but a single Impossible answer means they will leave with nothing.

programme.title: Mastermind

programme.title: Under the Vines
programme.desc: Sydney socialite Daisy Munroe and London lawyer Louis Oakley travel to New Zealand believing they are each sole heirs to a vineyard estate, only to discover that lawyer and vintner Vic Grimes’s definition of 'sole heirs' is flexible and that their idealistic notions of owning a vineyard, in reality, are less Tuscan romance and more dilapidated money pit. Finding themselves stuck with each other and a vineyard-sized problem to get rid off, they set about making a deal with influential locals Don and Marissa Silverton to sell it, but when the Peak View Wine Show brings a surprise for all, they wonder if the vineyard may not be as worthless as they first thought. programme.title: Wonders of Life
programme.desc: Brian travels across Australia to explore the physics of the size of life. He discovers that size has a profound effect on how you move, how you feed, even how long you live.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents the show in which experts invite members of the public to bring along their antiques for examination. Fascinating finds at St George's Hall in Liverpool include a light fitting from Hitler's Chancellery, a tie pin commemorating the death of Nelson, a picture frame so fine it needs no picture and the rarest of rare teapots.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from Haddon Hall in Derbyshire, where he is joined by experts Michael Baggot and Caroline Hawley. Together the team pick out a selection of interesting antiques and collectibles to be sold at a local auction. Michael finds a glorious scent bottle, but will he come out of it smelling of roses? Caroline gets a glimpse into the past by looking through a stereoscopic viewer. Paul also takes the opportunity for a look around Haddon Hall, where he meets the current owner Lord Edward Manners and delves into the history of beer as it would have been brewed in medieval times at Haddon Hall, making the most of the opportunity by sampling a couple of brews.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Josh Jones, Molly Rainford, Mark Rhodes and Sonia take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted with the very popular bee hotel?

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo’s railway journey through the islands of Sardinia and Corsica sees him leave Sardinia and arrive into Corsica, the most mountainous island in the Mediterranean. In Ajaccio, he delves into the early life of the island’s most famous son, Napoleon Bonaparte, discovering how Corsica’s unique approach to childhood shaped the future conqueror. At a bustling food market, Michael samples the island’s wild herbs. He is captivated by the haunting harmonies of polyphonic singing, a sound deeply woven into the island’s soul. He then boards the legendary Trinichellu, Corsica’s historic metre-gauge mountain railway, for a breathtaking journey through the island’s rugged interior. In the heart of the wilderness, Michael discovers how cutting-edge technology and drones are being used in the battle against devastating wildfires, a crucial innovation protecting Corsica and beyond.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: As milk production deadline day looms, Lucy and Adam race to finish the shed, buy more dairy cows and get them used to a new milking robot system. Callum and Zara have had a few difficult years since arriving on Arran, but their fortunes are at last turning as they build a future for their family. After a busy year, Andrew and Gayle hope their farming enterprises continue to grow and that grandad Terrence can take a step back.

programme.title: RHS Chelsea Flower Show
programme.desc: Monty Don, Arit Anderson and the team discover how gardens from the past are inspiring the latest looks at Chelsea this year. Frances Tophill explores the houseplant studios, Adam Frost has design ideas for garden seating, and Jamie Butterworth reveals this year’s colour trends. Monty celebrates the influence of Asian culture on our gardens, and Carol Klein explores the national plant collections in the Great Pavilion. Plus how you could help rescue some of Britain’s best-loved flowers.

programme.title: The Elon Musk Show
programme.desc: Another look at one of the world’s most polarising billionaires as he swaps rockets and electric cars for raw political power. The programme covers Musk’s tumultuous takeover of Twitter/X, the seismic fallouts of his personal life, and his evolution into a political force on both sides of the Atlantic. With immersive archive footage and revealing testimony from childhood friends, political insiders and former employees, this documentary charts how his quest to 'save humanity' collides with culture wars, AI breakthroughs and far-right movements in the US and UK.

programme.title: Carl Frampton - On Probation
programme.desc: Carl visits a former probationer facing fresh allegations of assault - but they are said to have happened years before she was on probation. As the threat of jail looms over her, Carl explores how the case wasn’t tried sooner and asks what will happen to the life she has built if she is found guilty. He also meets a woman who ended up behind bars for her first offence and finds out how probation has helped her find a purpose again.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day. With Paddy O'Connell.

programme.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
programme.desc: Responding to reports of a brick being thrown through a window, Dave and Jade enter a run-down building in south Belfast. Dave quickly realises they are in a drug den, and the men inside are squatting. An addict with a feeding tube in his nose tells Stephen how injecting cocaine has brought him to death’s door. On patrol in the city centre, Adam revisits the scene of a suicide that haunts him to this day. Jade reveals the mental price of being a frontline cop. Meanwhile, in the early hours of the morning, as the clubs spill out onto the streets, the Peelers’ car is attacked. Perri uses pepper spray to bring the suspect down, but as he, Jade and Adam wrestle with the man, a large crowd surrounds them. For the first time in his career, Perri hits his emergency button.

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob travel with their trusty terrier Ted to fish the mighty River Trent in Nottingham in search of barbel. In the large, wide river, they can sense the presence of big barbel, but will they land one? Later, they stay in a memorable party house with a bar, games room, nightclub and hot tubs. The boys can really relive their youths at this special place, but will they have the energy to stay up all night? There is a big surprise guest hiding at the venue, and Paul is almost speechless as he meets him, much to Bob’s delight - legendary DJ Tony Blackburn.

programme.title: This Is a Bomb: The Nevada Casino Heist
programme.desc: When the bomb detonates inside Harvey’s Wagon Wheel Casino, it leaves behind more than shattered concrete and twisted steel. There's a maze of unanswered questions, until a lucky break leads to a psychological stand-off. Calculated risks unravel, loyalties facture, and the truth proves far more complicated than anyone imagined.

programme.title: MasterChef
programme.desc: A brand new batch of amateur cooks enter the MasterChef kitchen, ready to compete in the first round and take their shot at culinary stardom.

programme.title: Panorama
programme.desc: Cute, funny, and sometimes surreal, AI-generated videos are flooding our social media feeds, but behind the dancing dogs and talking fruit lies a far darker world. In this Panorama investigation, reporter Marianna Spring explores how AI slop is shaping what we see, what we believe and who we can trust. From scam adverts and cloned voices to deepfake fraud, political manipulation and racially charged disinformation, the programme reveals how cheap and easily available AI tools are being weaponised. We ask, in the age of artificial intelligence, will seeing ever be believing again?

programme.title: MasterChef

programme.title: Planet Defenders
programme.desc: Jahawi is an underwater camera operator who is passionate about preserving the coastline of Kenya, his home country. The ocean is home to a whole host of marine wildlife, but one species here is particularly under threat: dolphins. This fun and curious mammal is facing a number of issues, as their habitat is being destroyed and the fish they eat are being depleted. There is also significant human activity on this coastline, which is damaging the marine life. However, Lamu has stood the test of time and is a marine sanctuary for them, with a new port being built and things about to change. Working with the Kenyan Marine Mammal Network, Jahawi is hoping to get the area protected as a marine reserve before it’s too late. It doesn’t take long for Jahawi to find the resident bottle-nosed dolphins as they enjoy swimming at the bow of the boat, and he soon gets into the water with the dolphins to get a closer look at these magnificent creatures. One species of dolphin he is hoping to find and film is the rare humpback dolphin.

programme.title: Operation Ouch!
programme.desc: Dr Xand’s favourite cold virus is the rhinovirus: that’s one that gets right up your nose and gives you the sniffles. So when the doctors get a question in the lab asking why your nose runs when you have a cold, they decide to become rhinoviruses and attack the body’s defences through a giant nose. We also get a chance to see right inside Dr Xand’s nostrils when he sticks a camera up his nose to show Dr Chris a real-life, flapping bogey specimen - gross alert! Dr Ronx makes a whole class of schoolchildren forget where their elbows are with a mind-blowing body trick you can try on your friends, and in Ouch and About, Ethan wants to know which is the strongest bone in his body. Over in Australia, six-year-old Jakobi is flown by helicopter to Sydney by the Flying Doctors because his local hospital thinks he needs specialist care. Lucy goes to the hospital in Edinburgh to find out why she’s woken up with a swollen face. And in Liverpool, Michael’s foot has been run over by a car, so no surprise that he’s ended up in the emergency department. Ouch!

programme.title: Planet Defenders
programme.desc: Jahawi is an underwater camera operator who is passionate about preserving the coastline of Kenya, his home country. The ocean is home to a whole host of marine wildlife, but one species here is particularly under threat: dolphins. This fun and curious mammal is facing a number of issues, as their habitat is being destroyed and the fish they eat are being depleted. There is also significant human activity on this coastline, which is damaging the marine life. However, Lamu has stood the test of time and is a marine sanctuary for them, with a new port being built and things about to change. Working with the Kenyan Marine Mammal Network, Jahawi is hoping to get the area protected as a marine reserve before it’s too late. It doesn’t take long for Jahawi to find the resident bottle-nosed dolphins as they enjoy swimming at the bow of the boat, and he soon gets into the water with the dolphins to get a closer look at these magnificent creatures. One species of dolphin he is hoping to find and film is the rare humpback dolphin.

programme.title: Operation Ouch!
programme.desc: Dr Xand’s favourite cold virus is the rhinovirus: that’s one that gets right up your nose and gives you the sniffles. So when the doctors get a question in the lab asking why your nose runs when you have a cold, they decide to become rhinoviruses and attack the body’s defences through a giant nose. We also get a chance to see right inside Dr Xand’s nostrils when he sticks a camera up his nose to show Dr Chris a real-life, flapping bogey specimen - gross alert! Dr Ronx makes a whole class of schoolchildren forget where their elbows are with a mind-blowing body trick you can try on your friends, and in Ouch and About, Ethan wants to know which is the strongest bone in his body. Over in Australia, six-year-old Jakobi is flown by helicopter to Sydney by the Flying Doctors because his local hospital thinks he needs specialist care. Lucy goes to the hospital in Edinburgh to find out why she’s woken up with a swollen face. And in Liverpool, Michael’s foot has been run over by a car, so no surprise that he’s ended up in the emergency department. Ouch!

programme.desc: Preschool animation. Tee wakes up super-early and wants to play immediately. Mo wonders how much zooming is needed before everybody needs a nap.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are teaching a nervous Chilli how to drive the Tatocar. Suddenly, the car starts moving back and forth! Evil Pea is using a remote control to send the Tatocar speeding backwards to the other side of the supermarket. The Tato Team must make an epic journey back to the veggie aisle to stop Evil Pea from taking over. When they finally make it back, they dress an egg up as Supertato and put it in the car. Now, it is Captain Chilli’s turn to use the remote and distract Evil Pea so that Supertato can save the fruit and veggies.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Coco is showing Bing how magnets work. While Coco builds a tower, Bing wants to find more magnetic things. In the garden he tests the ball, table and key, announcing which are magnetic. When Bing tries the watering can, he accidentally drops the magnet behind the flowerbed! Neither Bing nor Coco can reach it, so Flop shows them how to fish with magnets.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: It’s secret agent time when Mojo and Bo think Didi the tractor is up to something fishy. But can the two supersecret spies follow her without being spotted?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It's our favourite grumpy twosome, the Old Deers, introducing this episode, with their usual positive attitude about how everything was better in their day. We start with Duggee’s Counting Train, Hatsu the Pottery Poodle is on hand with a beautiful haiku about singing frogs and sleeping monkeys, and Ethel breaks the peace with a loud toot. Frog throws some shapes, then Enid and a mouse turn into Japanese anime for a colourful cartoon chase across the Clubhouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Chipmunk is cycling one day delivering his packages when he hits a rock and his trike falls apart! He has so many packages to deliver - what is he going to do now? Duggee offers to repair Delivery Chipmunk’s trike, but that will take too long. The packages need to be delivered right away or else! Duggee also has a delivery badge and he will try to deliver all of Chipmunk’s packages with the help of the Squirrels. Before they begin, they need to learn the rules of delivering. With some hard work, the Squirrels deliver all the packages and Delivery Chipmunk is alright again. The Squirrels have truly earned their delivery badge!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad tells the kids a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the 80s!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The kids are late for a playdate, but they can’t leave before they finish their game.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Glitch visits Rome to race his grimbots in the Colosseum. Can the Go Jetters stop him?

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Mr McGregor goes away for the day, Peter can't wait to raid the garden. But will the absence of one foe leave Peter and his little sister at the mercy of another?

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. Barnacles, Kwazii and Peso venture back inside a whale shark to retrieve a porcupine puffer fish that was accidentally swallowed.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: When Five and friends go missing from the five-star ball, Six to Ten discover they are all Five-and-a-friend! Learn about splitting numbers into smaller numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: It's talent night and A and R are trying to do some magic, but their card trick keeps going wrong. This episode introduces the '-ar-' digraph and has fun with the words hat, harp, carp, dark, card, tart, part, jar, car, cart, barn and far.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: Poppi the cat is missing, and the caravan is full of birds. What an exciting day! The Popcasters have an idea to help the birds, and along with Nick, they write today’s song. Will Poppi come home? Norman waits to find out.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella finds a bright red glove and has fun making up silly waving games with Lift. Together, they set off to explore the floors of Playtime Towers. In the Fortress of Fun, Kingsley and Queenie also have fun waving and play a game of ‘Wavey Wavey Snap’ with the Playtimers. In the Sing Song Forest, Tincy the Spider keeps spotting cheeky chickens in her web. Finally, in the Ice Disco, Hettie the Yeti is teaching the Playtimers a new dance - the funky spider!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing wants Flop to read him his favourite book as he has his bath, but Bing joins in with the story too enthusiastically. Flop suggests they finish the story in bed as books don't like baths. When the book falls into the bath, Bing is heartbroken, but Flop helps him to understand that even though the book is wet the story isn't.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘cake’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. There’s sticky cake, a sprinkles cake and even a muddy looking cake!

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: The bugs jump on a squeaky toy until it breaks.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou has a special drumming tree, but when he finds Dalvanius playing it, he gets upset. Lou realises he’s not such a good sharer.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: The Froglets try gardening, but can they grow a beautiful flower before everyone returns?

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos are at an art gallery where they see a man hang a painting on the wall. He realises he has hung it upside down and turns it around, while the Twirlywoos watch with interest. When he leaves the room, the Twirlywoos decide to turn all the paintings and sculptures in the room around, so that when the man returns with a crowd of gallery visitors, everything in the room is upside down! The Very Important Lady visits the boat, and as usual, she falls apart. The Twirlywoos try to put her back together, but they manage to build her upside down!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin meets Khaira for a gymnastics session, which includes balancing, jumping and some trampolining with George. Mr Tumble attempts a very big jump. There is origami in this spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words blocks, frog and trampoline.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies swap places in the Tubby Car and drive to the Hidey Hup. They swap places again on the Tubby Uppy Downy before going up and down.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Roman, Rose-May, Zachary, Thomas, Finley, Ferne and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! In this episode we meet a new friend, Baby Tiger. There are scarves inside everyone’s bags which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate scarves inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The baby song Scarves Are Waving! features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children balance buckets of water through an obstacle course, learn British Sign Language signs for up, water and fell down, then sing and sign Jack and Jill.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: James, Noah and Aaron are on a mission to tidy up the city centre garden for a party. They work alongside Chatterpot’s friends - a rake, a spade and Wheely the wheelbarrow.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: It’s a special day in the attic, but Rebecca seems to have forgotten all about it. Murphi has an inspirational idea for a 'bee-autiful' yogurt pot bee, the Mini Monsters transform paper plates into snappy-mouthed animals, and Rebecca gets a call from her uncle at the zoo. Finally, the Recycling Express inspires Murphi to help Rebecca turn different-sized cardboard boxes into a cake.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes start a massive roar off with all the other Vegesaurs.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey and Bingo are unable to grab a prize on a magic claw machine, Mum and Dad create their own version at home. But Dad isn't about to make winning easy.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to learn that Mr Wobbly, the jelly juggler, is coming to town, and they can’t wait to see him. But they become impatient, so Duggee makes sure to explain to them that the week will fly by and there’s a lot to be done in that time. Duggee explains that a week is made up of seven days and what activities he does each day to stay busy. Each squirrel excitedly shares their usual plans between Monday and Friday so that they have something to look forward to while they wait for Mr Wobbly’s arrival.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk to treasure island to play at being pirates looking for buried treasure. On the way they play a game of peekaboo, pull some funny faces, wave at a passing train and even spot a spooky drain!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Kyra and Khloe have some garden fun planned. First, they visit a garden centre to buy some new plants, before heading back home to plant them. It’s hard work, but Kyra is sure her flowers will grow to be nice and big. With the garden in full bloom, the sisters open their own garden juice bar and get busy squeezing fresh fruit juice. But what will Mum and Dad think of their tangy creation?

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Elsa is using salt fish to make a fishcake recipe she has learnt from her father. She starts by mashing potatoes with butter before adding lots of other tasty ingredients such as chives. Not everyone likes the taste of chives before they are cooked, but hopefully they will enjoy them in the finished recipe. When her friends arrive, Elsa greets them with a special pineapple drink served in pineapple-shaped cups. The fruity fun continues when Elsa’s dad brings a plantain salad for them to enjoy with their fishcakes.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Maddie explains how the Sun doesn’t move when we go from day to night, but how it’s the Earth turning on its axis that makes the sun appear in the morning and go away again at night. She uses a special time-lapse camera at sunset to show the Earth turning away from the Sun when it is ‘going down’ at night time. Next, Maddie heads to a solar panel farm. She uses her special thermal camera to help us see how the solar panel cells collect the Sun’s energy and turn it into electricity that we can use.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: It’s the Woofton Wolves’s last football match of the season, and Rayane is in danger of missing the second half. Can hearing dog Diesel help him save the game?

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: To meet some beautiful cheetahs, Aneeshwar and Lizzie lay down herbs and spices on logs in their enclosure. The two brothers love to find things with a strong odour! Aneeshwar and Lizzie see how the cheetahs use their sense of smell to track down these items. Next, they meet a pair of warthogs. These amazing animals are from Africa, and they have terrific tusks. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle isn’t allowed at school, so he’s being looked after by Connie, the Brooklyn-Bell’s neighbour, at her house. Connie has dressed as a dog and made a huge, doggy maze game from cushions and suitcases for her dog, Jelly, to race through with Waffle. Waffle asks for one more race through the maze at home but Jess explains that the time for noisy play is over and offers him a quiet cuddle instead. After dinner, Evie tells Jess she’s been given her first reading book at school and gets the book out of her school bag to show her Mum. Waffle sits next to Evie and watches her read. When he starts to say words from the book out loud, Evie wonders if he’s reading, but Jess and Simon refuse to believe it.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Baba wants to be an owl. Oona shows Baba that puffins are cool too.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of potatoes who sing songs in different genres. The Potatoes celebrate the four seasons and sing a folksy song about the exciting things that come with each one!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Oh dear. The builders next door are making so much noise that Yukee and her friends can’t hear themselves play their instruments! Instead of trying to drown out all that drilling and banging, what if they played along with it instead...?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs want to get their toy train all the way from Phillipsburg to Maddiesville, but Phillip is finding it hard to let go of his dream track layout. Can he find a way to listen to Maddie's ideas so that the train can keep going round and round?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When the Squirrels can’t figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea. A mobile library! The Squirrels set off with Duggee. Along the way, they help Tino find his creativity, King Tiger figure out his favourite ice cream flavour and Worm find her love of fantasy. The Squirrels learn just how helpful and informative a library can be!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Three opens a stampoline park, where her friends have splatty fun making inky prints of all the shapes they can make. Learn to recognise amounts on sight with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. Young Y wants to know why he can't sing with the vowels - but anything's possible if you try...

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Strike! Mr Tumble tests his bowling skills with his super shiny bowling ball, while Justin and his friends enjoy a day out at the bowling alley!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. Tinky Winky finds a party invitation and shows it to Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po. The invitation takes flight, and the Teletubbies follow it to find a Tiddlytubbies' party.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how owls play an important role in the environment. They find out that they are amazing hunters who help nature stay in balance and that lots of owls living in an area can be a sign that the habitat is healthy. On the way, they find out all about how owls’ amazing hearing and eyesight can help them hunt and spot an owl out looking for its prey!

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: The Fantastics playfully sack Georgie. Jaz is appointed as the team’s new coach but finds it harder than she thought. Georgie tries her hand at other jobs - with chaotic results.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: CBeebies’ very own motorbike rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that are all used in airports. Grace uses a baggage loader to unload and load an aeroplane, shows off jet bridges and uses a pushback tug to move an aeroplane onto the runway.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: Woofer is inspired by a book about outer space and vows to build his own spaceship.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster is partnered with Bad Idea Puppy for the three-legged race.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: The Octonauts stage a pirate-worthy rescue as young, three-toed sloths drift out to sea.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Mr Tod and Sammy Whiskers team up to strike the rabbits' big picnic, Peter must team up with the only rabbit who can match him for speed and cunning - his mum.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: King Tiger interrupts the Squirrels' quiet time when he turns up at the Clubhouse with a magic hat on instead of his crown. He puts on a magic show for the Squirrels, making things appear and disappear to enthusiastic requests.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Tidbit needs help from his friends when he overpacks and gets injured on a hike.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea wears a giant suit so powerful it knocks Supertato across the supermarket aisles. Carrot and Supertato plan to outsmart Evil Pea so she’ll lose her new powers.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings need help building a toy castle, but Weasy really wants to play on his new game console. He spots an invention from the Farm of the Future: an instant cloning machine. He decides to clone himself so that his double can help the ducklings instead.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Somebody stole the big hand off the clock tower. Mojo and Bo are on the case, but it is not as simple as it seems. Soon, they are pulling off a heist they never expected.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad tells the kids a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the 80s!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The kids are late for a playdate, but they can’t leave before they finish their game.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog and the doctors do their best to care for Twiggy until his demands become too much. Once they realise what is really wrong, they help Twiggy feel special again.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: Ava’s solar gadgets malfunction, making her doubt her skills. But with PC Plum’s encouragement, she realises that each invention needs a different-sized solar panel.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is sad that Mrs Hobbs and her cat, George, are soon to leave Maple Close. The Brooklyn-Bells call on Mrs Hobbs to persuade her not to move house, only to find that her cat, George, has fleas. They offer to help and discover a secret about Mrs Hobbs.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi wants to blow a bubble just like her dads, but no matter how hard she tries, it won’t work. She makes a wish and creates a huge, magical bubble that floats around the park. As Rafi chases after it, the bubble spreads wonder wherever it goes. But when the bubble finally pops, Rafi is heartbroken. With help from her dads and friends, Rafi realises that bubbles aren’t meant to last forever, and that some of the most special moments are wonderful because they are fleeting.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran take the bus to visit the art gallery. JoJo wants to find paintings of pandas, so they join a tour with curator Marie and see lots of different type of art, and experience how abstract art makes them feel. JoJo can’t find any paintings of pandas but realises art isn't just for looking at – it's for making too! JoJo makes lots of panda art and creates her own gallery in Gran Gran's garden.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck are excited about seeing some shooting stars.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: While out practising her flying, Baby Skymoo is relying on the Cloud to catch her if her flying abilities let her down. And the Cloud is happy to help. But this time Baby Skymoo flies in another direction, and the Cloud isn’t there to help. Helpless, Baby Skymoo falls through one of the holes in the Clangers’ planet and lands up in Mother’s garden. She isn’t hurt, but how is she going to get back out of the underground caves and find her mother again? Luckily, the Cloud is summoned to the rescue.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa tidy up some colourful balls but can’t find the right home for a squishy ball. They bring the ball to the Play Tree and play with a shape sorter. The squishy ball gets stuck inside, and the shapes won’t fit. In Yummy Land, when there aren’t enough seats at the table, MeMo uses the squishy ball as a seat. At BeddyByes time, Gramma Leeba finds the perfect home for the squishy ball.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures. The Pontipines are out for a walk in the garden. What is that noise? Upsy Daisy is singing, Makka Pakka is stacking stones and the Tombliboos are playing their Tombliboo music! Igglepiggle is out for a long walk, skipping through the garden. He goes so far that he gets lost. The Pontipines use the trubliphone to get everyone to make even more noise so that Igglepiggle can follow the noise back to his friends.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Talia Mar reads a brilliant Bedtime Story about princesses doing things their own way!

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s Leek, who won’t let anything, not even the chilly conditions backstage, stop him from singing his song Can’t Hold Me Down.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing takes his Hoppity Voosh toy to the park to see the ducks and play on the slide. But when he steps in dog poo and heads to Amma's house to get cleaned up, he leaves Hoppity behind. Amma helps Bing to focus so that he can remember where he went and retrace his steps to find Hoppity.

programme.desc: It’s a special day in the attic, but Rebecca seems to have forgotten all about it. Murphi has an inspirational idea for a 'bee-autiful' yogurt pot bee, the Mini Monsters transform paper plates into snappy-mouthed animals, and Rebecca gets a call from her uncle at the zoo. Finally, the Recycling Express inspires Murphi to help Rebecca turn different-sized cardboard boxes into a cake.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes start a massive roar off with all the other Vegesaurs.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey and Bingo are unable to grab a prize on a magic claw machine, Mum and Dad create their own version at home. But Dad isn't about to make winning easy.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to learn that Mr Wobbly, the jelly juggler, is coming to town, and they can’t wait to see him. But they become impatient, so Duggee makes sure to explain to them that the week will fly by and there’s a lot to be done in that time. Duggee explains that a week is made up of seven days and what activities he does each day to stay busy. Each squirrel excitedly shares their usual plans between Monday and Friday so that they have something to look forward to while they wait for Mr Wobbly’s arrival.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk to treasure island to play at being pirates looking for buried treasure. On the way they play a game of peekaboo, pull some funny faces, wave at a passing train and even spot a spooky drain!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Kyra and Khloe have some garden fun planned. First, they visit a garden centre to buy some new plants, before heading back home to plant them. It’s hard work, but Kyra is sure her flowers will grow to be nice and big. With the garden in full bloom, the sisters open their own garden juice bar and get busy squeezing fresh fruit juice. But what will Mum and Dad think of their tangy creation?

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Elsa is using salt fish to make a fishcake recipe she has learnt from her father. She starts by mashing potatoes with butter before adding lots of other tasty ingredients such as chives. Not everyone likes the taste of chives before they are cooked, but hopefully they will enjoy them in the finished recipe. When her friends arrive, Elsa greets them with a special pineapple drink served in pineapple-shaped cups. The fruity fun continues when Elsa’s dad brings a plantain salad for them to enjoy with their fishcakes.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Maddie explains how the Sun doesn’t move when we go from day to night, but how it’s the Earth turning on its axis that makes the sun appear in the morning and go away again at night. She uses a special time-lapse camera at sunset to show the Earth turning away from the Sun when it is ‘going down’ at night time. Next, Maddie heads to a solar panel farm. She uses her special thermal camera to help us see how the solar panel cells collect the Sun’s energy and turn it into electricity that we can use.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: It’s the Woofton Wolves’s last football match of the season, and Rayane is in danger of missing the second half. Can hearing dog Diesel help him save the game?

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: To meet some beautiful cheetahs, Aneeshwar and Lizzie lay down herbs and spices on logs in their enclosure. The two brothers love to find things with a strong odour! Aneeshwar and Lizzie see how the cheetahs use their sense of smell to track down these items. Next, they meet a pair of warthogs. These amazing animals are from Africa, and they have terrific tusks. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle isn’t allowed at school, so he’s being looked after by Connie, the Brooklyn-Bell’s neighbour, at her house. Connie has dressed as a dog and made a huge, doggy maze game from cushions and suitcases for her dog, Jelly, to race through with Waffle. Waffle asks for one more race through the maze at home but Jess explains that the time for noisy play is over and offers him a quiet cuddle instead. After dinner, Evie tells Jess she’s been given her first reading book at school and gets the book out of her school bag to show her Mum. Waffle sits next to Evie and watches her read. When he starts to say words from the book out loud, Evie wonders if he’s reading, but Jess and Simon refuse to believe it.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Baba wants to be an owl. Oona shows Baba that puffins are cool too.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of potatoes who sing songs in different genres. The Potatoes celebrate the four seasons and sing a folksy song about the exciting things that come with each one!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Oh dear. The builders next door are making so much noise that Yukee and her friends can’t hear themselves play their instruments! Instead of trying to drown out all that drilling and banging, what if they played along with it instead...?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs want to get their toy train all the way from Phillipsburg to Maddiesville, but Phillip is finding it hard to let go of his dream track layout. Can he find a way to listen to Maddie's ideas so that the train can keep going round and round?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When the Squirrels can’t figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea. A mobile library! The Squirrels set off with Duggee. Along the way, they help Tino find his creativity, King Tiger figure out his favourite ice cream flavour and Worm find her love of fantasy. The Squirrels learn just how helpful and informative a library can be!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Three opens a stampoline park, where her friends have splatty fun making inky prints of all the shapes they can make. Learn to recognise amounts on sight with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. Young Y wants to know why he can't sing with the vowels - but anything's possible if you try...

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Strike! Mr Tumble tests his bowling skills with his super shiny bowling ball, while Justin and his friends enjoy a day out at the bowling alley!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. Tinky Winky finds a party invitation and shows it to Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po. The invitation takes flight, and the Teletubbies follow it to find a Tiddlytubbies' party.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how owls play an important role in the environment. They find out that they are amazing hunters who help nature stay in balance and that lots of owls living in an area can be a sign that the habitat is healthy. On the way, they find out all about how owls’ amazing hearing and eyesight can help them hunt and spot an owl out looking for its prey!

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: The Fantastics playfully sack Georgie. Jaz is appointed as the team’s new coach but finds it harder than she thought. Georgie tries her hand at other jobs - with chaotic results.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: CBeebies’ very own motorbike rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that are all used in airports. Grace uses a baggage loader to unload and load an aeroplane, shows off jet bridges and uses a pushback tug to move an aeroplane onto the runway.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: Woofer is inspired by a book about outer space and vows to build his own spaceship.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster is partnered with Bad Idea Puppy for the three-legged race.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: The Octonauts stage a pirate-worthy rescue as young, three-toed sloths drift out to sea.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Mr Tod and Sammy Whiskers team up to strike the rabbits' big picnic, Peter must team up with the only rabbit who can match him for speed and cunning - his mum.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: King Tiger interrupts the Squirrels' quiet time when he turns up at the Clubhouse with a magic hat on instead of his crown. He puts on a magic show for the Squirrels, making things appear and disappear to enthusiastic requests.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Tidbit needs help from his friends when he overpacks and gets injured on a hike.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea wears a giant suit so powerful it knocks Supertato across the supermarket aisles. Carrot and Supertato plan to outsmart Evil Pea so she’ll lose her new powers.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings need help building a toy castle, but Weasy really wants to play on his new game console. He spots an invention from the Farm of the Future: an instant cloning machine. He decides to clone himself so that his double can help the ducklings instead.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Somebody stole the big hand off the clock tower. Mojo and Bo are on the case, but it is not as simple as it seems. Soon, they are pulling off a heist they never expected.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad tells the kids a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the 80s!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The kids are late for a playdate, but they can’t leave before they finish their game.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog and the doctors do their best to care for Twiggy until his demands become too much. Once they realise what is really wrong, they help Twiggy feel special again.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: Ava’s solar gadgets malfunction, making her doubt her skills. But with PC Plum’s encouragement, she realises that each invention needs a different-sized solar panel.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is sad that Mrs Hobbs and her cat, George, are soon to leave Maple Close. The Brooklyn-Bells call on Mrs Hobbs to persuade her not to move house, only to find that her cat, George, has fleas. They offer to help and discover a secret about Mrs Hobbs.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi wants to blow a bubble just like her dads, but no matter how hard she tries, it won’t work. She makes a wish and creates a huge, magical bubble that floats around the park. As Rafi chases after it, the bubble spreads wonder wherever it goes. But when the bubble finally pops, Rafi is heartbroken. With help from her dads and friends, Rafi realises that bubbles aren’t meant to last forever, and that some of the most special moments are wonderful because they are fleeting.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran take the bus to visit the art gallery. JoJo wants to find paintings of pandas, so they join a tour with curator Marie and see lots of different type of art, and experience how abstract art makes them feel. JoJo can’t find any paintings of pandas but realises art isn't just for looking at – it's for making too! JoJo makes lots of panda art and creates her own gallery in Gran Gran's garden.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck are excited about seeing some shooting stars.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: While out practising her flying, Baby Skymoo is relying on the Cloud to catch her if her flying abilities let her down. And the Cloud is happy to help. But this time Baby Skymoo flies in another direction, and the Cloud isn’t there to help. Helpless, Baby Skymoo falls through one of the holes in the Clangers’ planet and lands up in Mother’s garden. She isn’t hurt, but how is she going to get back out of the underground caves and find her mother again? Luckily, the Cloud is summoned to the rescue.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa tidy up some colourful balls but can’t find the right home for a squishy ball. They bring the ball to the Play Tree and play with a shape sorter. The squishy ball gets stuck inside, and the shapes won’t fit. In Yummy Land, when there aren’t enough seats at the table, MeMo uses the squishy ball as a seat. At BeddyByes time, Gramma Leeba finds the perfect home for the squishy ball.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures. The Pontipines are out for a walk in the garden. What is that noise? Upsy Daisy is singing, Makka Pakka is stacking stones and the Tombliboos are playing their Tombliboo music! Igglepiggle is out for a long walk, skipping through the garden. He goes so far that he gets lost. The Pontipines use the trubliphone to get everyone to make even more noise so that Igglepiggle can follow the noise back to his friends.

programme.desc: Talia Mar reads a brilliant Bedtime Story about princesses doing things their own way!

Set in the heart of The Peak District, six households from across the UK move into a 'picture-perfect' village to compete for a massive £250,000 prize. As the close wave goodbye to another household, the competition ramps up in the final stages of the game. Giving the neighbours a chance to bond, Graham puts on some communal activities, a life-drawing class and a game of rounders. programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the team are in Essex helping David, who wants rid of his girlfriend Amanda's bargain buys. programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Graham Norton hosts The Neighbourhood, a brand-new high stakes, street-sized popularity contest. Set in the heart of The Peak District, six households from across the UK move into a 'picture-perfect' village to compete for a massive £250,000 prize. As the close wave goodbye to another household, the competition ramps up in the final stages of the game. Giving the neighbours a chance to bond, Graham puts on some communal activities, a life-drawing class and a game of rounders. Later, the households face their next immunity challenge, 'Escape the Greenhouse'. Who will secure safety at a crucial point in the competition? At the removal, Graham's shocking twist throws the neighbours into chaos, breaking bonds and burning bridges. Can any friendships come out unscathed?

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the team are in Essex helping David, who wants rid of his girlfriend Amanda's bargain buys. David has a vintage candy floss business and Amanda runs a retro ice cream parlour, so they're a match made in sugar heaven - but Amanda is the Bear Grylls of the bargain hunt, and has filled their home office with all her finds. Underneath the mountain of clutter are desks, and as busy entrepreneurs David needs the office cleared pronto! Whether it's shoes, expensive handbags, collectable artwork or even Amanda's jewellery, David is adamant it all needs to be sold. Hidden in the clutter, David discovers his Dad's old reel to reel tape of The Beatles that he's never listened to - if it's an original unknown recording, Dan reveals they could be sitting on a life-changing amount of money! Completely unaware her items have been boxed up and valued, Amanda returns home to the shock of a lifetime. Will the newly-cleared office be enough to tempt her to take the cash?

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the team are in Essex helping David, who wants rid of his girlfriend Amanda's bargain buys.
